1. Open Remote on your computer. Choose the project you want to share. 2. Scan or paste the pairing code. Scan a QR when offered, or use the copy and paste buttons. 3. Approve on your computer. Confirm the phone you are pairing. 4. Continue from your phone. Choose a model. Follow the work. Review the changes.
